doc.name: SnowSure Answer Engine
doc.description: Grounded conversational agent for ski & snow questions across 600+ resorts: live conditions, 7-day multi-model forecasts (14-day with Pro), the SnowSure Score, trip planning, and resort detail. Answers are grounded in SnowSure's verified data — never open web search.

skills.name: Snow conditions & forecast Q&A
skills.description: Answer natural-language questions about current snow conditions, base depth, the SnowSure Score, and 7-day multi-model forecasts (14-day with Pro) for any of 600+ resorts.
examples: Is it a good week to ski Chamonix?
Which Japan resorts have the deepest base this week?
What is the SnowSure score and base depth at Zermatt today?

skills.name: Ski trip planning
skills.description: Recommend resorts and timing for a trip based on conditions, ability, region, and dates.
examples: Plan a 5-day ski trip to Colorado in late January
Where should I ski this weekend for the best conditions?
